f0_delta_u.hint: Work done by the sample counts negative: ΔU = q + w_on.

f0_delta_s.hint: Divide the reversible heat (J) by the absolute temperature (K); the result is in J/K.

f0_try_h.hint: H = U + pV; with p in Pa and V in m³, pV is in J.

f0_try_f.hint: F = U − TS, with TS in J.

f0_try_g.hint: G = H − TS, or F + pV.
